verdicts.reason: Both break the product: the cream circle is pulled off the can, cropped at the bottom-left edge and overlapping it, and the can sits outline-only, orange on orange. A is worse: 'Out now.' is shrunk to an unreadable size and placed far below the headline, so the pair no longer reads as a group, and the headline floats in empty space. B keeps 'Out now.' readable and left-aligned under the headline, with a cleaner path from headline to CTA, but it has the same broken can and circle and a large empty middle.
